scenery_meta.artistComments: Terminal 1 extension added (in operation since April 28, 2026). The missing area south of runway 08L has been added. Lines and markings throughout the airport revised. Pavement FX edge added to all taxiways. Some roudes draped polygons changed to terrain_FX lines. Fuel hydrants on aprons added. All apron lighting has been converted to float_2_led.obs. Ground and taxi routes adjusted. I am in contact with Jan regarding these changes.
